product_launches.description: Headway launched an expanded EHR platform for mental health providers, adding AI-assisted notes that turn session summaries into insurance-ready progress notes, plus integrated telehealth, documentation, and billing. The EHR is free for providers.

overview_description.description: Headway is a mental healthcare system that helps users have access to affordable healthcare. It operates a virtual network of therapists that accept insurance and provide video or in-person sessions booked completely online. It also helps mental healthcare providers expand their practices and individuals to save money on mental health sessions.

about_short_description.short_description: Headway builds a mental healthcare system that enables therapists to accept insurance and scale their practices.

product.name: Headway Provider Platform
product.description: A platform and provider network that helps therapists and psychiatrists accept insurance, manage patient care, and operate private or group practices.

product.name: Insurance Credentialing and Paneling
product.description: A service that helps mental health providers obtain insurance credentials and join participating health plans across the states where they are licensed.

product.name: Insurance Billing and Claims Services
product.description: Administrative services for benefits verification, claim submission, billing administration, and payment collection for mental health practices.

product.name: Headway EHR
product.description: An electronic health record and practice-management system with scheduling, messaging, documentation, and assessment features for mental health providers.

product.name: Provider Reimbursement and Payment Services
product.description: A payment service that provides reimbursement to participating providers at contracted rates, with scheduled biweekly payments for eligible care.

product.name: Clinician Education and Practice Support
product.description: Educational and operational support for mental health providers, including continuing education, clinical resources, practice partners, and clinical office hours.
